title: Planet Tweaks V2.8.4 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — AFK Macro (Anti-Idle Key Presser) & Bulletproof Update Installer Launch
releaseNotes: AFK Macro: New macro template that taps any keyboard key you choose on a timer from 1 to 59 minutes (example: Jump every 2 minutes) so you never get kicked for idling. Pick the key, drag the minutes slider (changes apply live), arm it with Start Macro, then press your hotkey to start and stop. First tap fires instantly, stop is instant, keyboard keys only (no mouse clicks), normal mode only. Update Installer Fix: The in-app updater now validates the download (size, executable header, no HTML error pages), then hands the installer to a detached launcher that waits for Planet Tweaks to fully exit, opens the installer as admin, confirms the setup window appeared and brings it to the front. The installer scripts no longer kill their own process tree (the real reason the installer never opened). If anything ever fails, a visible fallback opens Explorer on the downloaded installer instead of failing silently. Diagnostics log: %LOCALAPPDATA%\PlanetTweaks\update_launcher.log.
